_comment: Curated alias table for Estonian state institutions (issue #118). Maps a historical/predecessor institution slug -> the canonical successor slug. Slugs are the lowercase, transliterated IRI suffixes used in krr_outputs/institutions/institution_<slug>.json (so estleg:Institution_<slug>) — '-'/spaces collapse to a single '_'. The extractor (scripts/extract_institutional_competence.py) applies this map AFTER the Estonian noun-stem normaliser: a detected suffix that matches an alias key is replaced by its canonical value, so a pre-merger reference (e.g. 'Maksuamet') resolves to the post-merger institution node ('Maksu- ja Tolliamet'). validate_all.py::validate_institution_registry_consistency checks every 'canonical' target resolves to an institution_<slug>.json file. Conservative: only well-documented agency mergers/renames are listed. Issue #718: the alias no longer erases the predecessor. A provision that names a predecessor still binds competentAuthority to the canonical successor (legal succession), and ALSO records estleg:mentionsInstitution -> estleg:Institution_<alias key>; a non-binding mention points only at the predecessor node. Every alias key therefore has its own predecessor institution node (label = 'label', successor/validity in data/institution_identity.json).

maksuamet.label: Maksuamet
maksuamet.evidence: Maksuamet and Tolliamet merged into Maksu- ja Tolliamet on 2004-02-01.

tolliamet.label: Tolliamet
tolliamet.evidence: Tolliamet merged with Maksuamet into Maksu- ja Tolliamet on 2004-02-01.

politseiamet.label: Politseiamet
politseiamet.evidence: Politseiamet, Piirivalveamet and Kodakondsus- ja Migratsiooniamet merged into Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet on 2010-01-01.

piirivalveamet.label: Piirivalveamet
piirivalveamet.evidence: Piirivalveamet merged into Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet on 2010-01-01.

kodakondsus_ja_migratsiooniamet.label: Kodakondsus- ja Migratsiooniamet
kodakondsus_ja_migratsiooniamet.evidence: Kodakondsus- ja Migratsiooniamet's functions transferred to Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet on 2010-01-01.

tervisekaitseamet.label: Tervisekaitseamet
tervisekaitseamet.evidence: Tervisekaitseamet (renamed Tervisekaitseinspektsioon in 1999, then merged into Terviseamet on 2010-01-01).

tarbijakaitseamet.label: Tarbijakaitseamet
tarbijakaitseamet.evidence: Tarbijakaitseamet and Tehnilise Jarelevalve Amet merged into Tarbijakaitse ja Tehnilise Jarelevalve Amet on 2019-01-01.

veterinaar_ja_toiduamet.label: Veterinaar- ja Toiduamet
veterinaar_ja_toiduamet.evidence: Veterinaar- ja Toiduamet and Pollumajandusamet merged into Pollumajandus- ja Toiduamet on 2021-01-01.

pollumajandusamet.label: Põllumajandusamet
pollumajandusamet.evidence: Pollumajandusamet merged with Veterinaar- ja Toiduamet into Pollumajandus- ja Toiduamet on 2021-01-01.

maanteeamet.label: Maanteeamet
maanteeamet.evidence: Maanteeamet, Lennuamet and Veeteede Amet merged into Transpordiamet on 2021-01-01.
